title: Prisma with API Routes
description: Use Prisma in Next.js Pages Router API routes for projects still using the Pages Router.

data.text: If your project still uses the Pages Router, you can access Prisma Client in API routes via `getServerSideProps` or the `pages/api` directory.

data.title: API Route
data.content: Create an API route that returns published posts.

data.text: For page-level data fetching, use `getServerSideProps` to fetch data with Prisma on every request.

data.title: getServerSideProps
data.content: Fetch posts server-side for a page.

data.title: Migration Note
data.text: If you are migrating from Pages Router to App Router, Route Handlers and Server Actions are the recommended replacements for API routes.
